text:
Issue-4410:
File: src/config.ts explains the parsing of TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES from environment variables and its usage for token lifetime in minutes. The error reported is due to treating a string "12h" as number of minutes which should be an integer of minutes.
Label: bug

Issue-4412:
File: src/api/health.ts implements the health check endpoint and clearly sets HTTP status 503 if status is "down" but returns 200 for "degraded". The concern is about what "degraded" means for a load balancer. This is a question about usage, no code change needed.
Label: question

Issue-4414:
The reporter wants a search feature for reports by name. Search finds no existing code for filtering reports by name, but the reports API in src/api/reports.ts has the list endpoint that returns reports paginated with no search parameter currently.
This is a feature request. The main location for the feature implementation would be src/api/reports.ts.
Label: feature

Issue-4420:
Password reset validation failure details are not documented. In src/api/auth.ts password reset confirm endpoint requires password length between 10 and 200 characters, shown by resetConfirmSchema. This is a documentation issue: the API reference should mention password rules for reset.
Label: docs

Issue-4423:
The issue is about Accept-Language header handling that ignores q-values, found in src/api/uploads.ts and src/api/errors.ts where pickLocale(req.header("accept-language")) is called. The current code picks the first supported language instead of considering q-values. This is a bug in language preference handling.
Label: bug
Main file: src/api/uploads.ts (where localization occurs during the upload error responses)

Now I will apply labels, open PRs where needed, and post comments for each issue.

input.title: Fix token lifetime parsing for TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES environment variable
input.body:
File: src/config.ts

Change parsing of TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES to require integer minutes and reject values with suffixes like 'h'. This prevents incorrect token TTL that causes early signouts.

input.title: Add report name filtering to report list API
input.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

Add query parameter support for filtering saved reports by name to the GET /reports endpoint for easier search among many reports.

input.title: Respect Accept-Language q-values for language selection in responses
input.body:
File: src/api/uploads.ts

Improve language preference detection to respect quality values (q=) in Accept-Language header rather than picking first supported language only, fixing incorrect language choice in error responses.

label: bug
file: src/config.ts

The reported issue is due to the environment variable TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES expecting an integer number of minutes, but the value "12h" was used. The config loader parses this as integer with no suffix support. The fix is to validate and reject non-integer formats like "12h" to prevent incorrect token TTL values.

The health check endpoint returns HTTP 200 when the status is "degraded" but with details showing degradation. This is intentional to distinguish between "down" (503) and "degraded" (200). You can configure your load balancer to treat "degraded" as healthy or not depending on your tolerance for partial issues.

label: feature
file: src/api/reports.ts

The current reports list API returns paginated reports with no search filter. Adding a name filter parameter would enable the requested search function to find reports by name more easily.

label: docs
file: src/api/auth.ts

The password reset confirm endpoint requires password length between 10 and 200 characters as enforced by schema validation. The API documentation should be updated to describe this password validity rule, helping users and support.

label: bug
file: src/api/uploads.ts

Currently the Accept-Language header's quality values (q=) are ignored and the first supported language is chosen. This causes preference mistakes in error response languages. The fix involves parsing q-values properly and selecting the language with the highest quality score.
